items.feature: Backup, restore and manual (US33): restore verifies the backup

points.what: Story 1 (Highest, section 1 of docs/audit-remediation-stories.md): restore verifies the complete backup before replacing live data. AC: backup whose database references a missing logo makes restore fail before replacement with records, key and uploads intact; valid backup without referenced uploads restores even without an uploads dir; failure during replacement reports failure and the previous installation is recoverable from the reported location. Tests: missing dir, one missing referenced file, empty installation, injected failure after first replacement, byte comparison, Makefile entry point on a disposable volume. Measure: shared Definition of Done of docs/audit-remediation-stories.md (regression test failing on old code, CI green, reviewed, zero known bugs, owner acceptance). Never reset, seed or migrate:fresh the omc-studio database; tests and restore trials only on disposable data or a disposable volume.
points.why: Audit finding 1: restore removes live files before replacements are copied and accepts backups with missing logos
